summary: Backend API testing for iteration 80 - Bank Statement Reconciliation feature. All 18 tests passed. Verified: CSV parsing with multiple column formats, fee/card payment filtering, client name matching, payment recording, loan creation from negative amounts, overpayment handling with extra_interest, and loan_fully_paid flag.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: When clients are created via /api/clients, the outstanding_balance is set to loan_amount (not loan_amount * (1 + interest_rate/100)). Interest is not automatically applied to total_amount_due on client creation. This means extra_interest in bank reconciliation is calculated from outstanding_balance, not from expected total_due with interest.

loan_creation.details: Negative amounts create/update loan for matched client

unmatched_transactions.details: Transactions with no matching client returned in unmatched_transactions list

seed_data_creation: Created test clients with TEST_ prefix for reconciliation testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bank statement reconciliation endpoint fully tested. CSV parsing supports multiple column formats (name/beneficiary/partner, amount/sum/value, date/kuupäev, description/selgitus). Fee keywords include: teenustasu, service fee, kaardimakse, pos, visa, mastercard. Minimum 70% name match score required. Negative amounts = loan disbursement, positive amounts = payment. Note: Client creation does not auto-calculate interest in outstanding_balance.
